environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18) connected to Aurora PostgreSQL 15.4. The DB user configured in DB_PASSWORD is 'app_service' which is a superuser role (rds_superuser member) used during initial development. RLS policies exist on tables but the app_service role has BYPASSRLS privilege. JWT_SECRET is a static HMAC key. API Gateway passes all requests directly to Lambda with no request validation or transformation. No WAF or API Gateway request validators configured.

config.rls_policies: defined but bypassed due to role privilege
config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation, proxy integration
config.network: Lambda in VPC, direct connectivity to Aurora
